verdict.rationale: The only dependent-related evidence is an educational H-4 guide on Lighthouse's site. It explains eligibility and EAD rules but never says Lighthouse prepares or files dependent petitions (O-3, H-4, or EAD) as part of its service. The pricing and visa pages list no dependent filings, so this is adjacent content rather than a documented service capability.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service
